description: We are conducting a confidential search for a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a facility committed to providing high-quality patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall operational management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations, and driving continuous improvement in patient outcomes and staff performance. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the facility's culture and achieving its strategic goals.This full-time position offers a competitive salary package, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. We are seeking a visionary leader ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a track record of operational excellence.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Strong financial management and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
